children: on Friday disclosed withdrawal requests during the third quarter across four of its private credit funds.

HPS Corporate Lending Fund received repurchase requests totaling ~11.5% of shares outstanding during Q3. Requests remained below ~13.3% seen in the second quarter. HLEND is set to repurchase 5.0% of shares outstanding as of June 30, or ~$600M.

At BlackRock Private Credit Fund, about 3,193,088 shares of common stock, or ~4.58%, were validly tendered pursuant to the fund's tender offer for up to 5% of shares outstanding. The offer expired on September 4.

BlackRock Private Investments Fund estimates ~175,858 shares, or 0.51% of the shares outstanding as of June 30, were validly tendered pursuant to a tender offer for up to 5% that expired on August 31.

And, HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund estimates that about 1.9% of shares outstanding, or 946,847 shares, were validly tendered as of June 30 pursuant to a tender offer for up to 5% of shares outstanding that expired on September 4.
